bug_semantics: In applyNaive (pkg/archive/tar.go), image unpack previously called fs.RootPath live for every tar entry so parent paths were re-walked and re-bounded to the unpack root. CVE-2025-47290 is a sequential TOCTOU (CWE-367) introduced when those RootPath results were memoized in cachedRootPath.get: after the first walk of a parent path, later entries reuse the cached lexical path and then create/link through it. A crafted layer can create a directory, have its resolved path cached as in-root, replace that directory with a symlink (or otherwise mutate the tree), and then unpack further names under the stale cached parent so kernel path resolution follows the symlink out of the unpack root onto the host filesystem. The same cache is used by hardlinkRootPath. Only containerd v2.1.0 is affected; v2.1.1 restores per-entry fs.RootPath.
flaw_origin: The cache was added as a performance change in d8063c30dd05ca71e7b2d8d78360af6835dd5e46 (PR #11337, 'perf(applyNaive): avoid walking the tree for each file in the same directory'), which first wrote cachedRootPath and replaced live fs.RootPath(root, ppath) / hardlinkRootPath walks with rootPath.get. The parent tree still used uncached RootPath. The security fix is a straight revert of that commit.

reasoning: The advisory is a real published CVE (CVE.org PUBLISHED; GHSA not withdrawn): a TOCTOU during image unpack in containerd v2.1.0 that lets a crafted image write outside the unpack root. The mechanism is the memoization of fs.RootPath in applyNaive. Before the perf change, every tar entry re-walked parent components and re-evaluated symlinks against the current tree; after it, a cached in-root parent path is reused even if a later tar entry has replaced that parent with a symlink, so subsequent creates/hardlinks follow the symlink onto the host. git log -S/-L and parent-tree grep show d8063c30dd05ca71e7b2d8d78360af6835dd5e46 as the smallest public commit that first wrote cachedRootPath; its parent 2fda52edee18f9eaf573521b6620d2f5b6473781 still has live fs.RootPath and no cache. That commit is a one-parent merge-PR member (PR #11337), not a squash/move/revert, so it is the BIC. It is in v2.1.0 and absent from v2.0.x, matching the vendor affected range. The fix is a revert of that same commit: 38c9bb93 on main (merged by advisory-cited cada132) and cherry-pick ac00b8e on release/2.1, which is the commit present in patched tag v2.1.1 where cachedRootPath is gone.
